description: Sync customer accounts, invoices, subscriptions and transactions from one Recurly site. Invoices, subscriptions and transactions link to their account.
opening: Sync customer accounts, invoices, subscriptions and transactions from one Recurly site. Each record is one document with a readable summary, with amounts shown in their currency, such as `49.99 USD`. Invoices, subscriptions and transactions link to the account they belong to.

Recurly permissions are not imported, so every synced record is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Records deleted in Recurly stay in HydraDB. Plans, coupons, adjustments and billing info are not synced as documents.

connect.auth: Recurly uses a private API key together with your site's subdomain.

credentials.name: subdomain
credentials.text: Your Recurly site code, for example `acme` for `acme.recurly.com`.

credentials.name: user_agent
credentials.text: Filled in automatically. Leave it empty.

steps.title: Get a private API key
steps.text: Get a private API key for your Recurly site.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the key as `api_key` and your site code as `subdomain`.

steps.title: Select the site
steps.text: Select the `All data` resource. It syncs accounts, invoices, subscriptions and transactions together. You cannot select these record types separately.

connect.account: One connector reads one Recurly site.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads accounts, invoices and subscriptions updated since the last sync, and transactions collected since the last sync.
sync.edits: An edited account, invoice or subscription replaces its document. Transactions are found by when they were collected, so a later change to a collected transaction's status may not be picked up.
sync.deletes: Deleted records are not removed. A record deleted in Recurly stays searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: updated_at
shared_attributes.text: When the record was last updated in Recurly. When there is none, the creation time is used, and for a transaction then the collection time. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.recurly_id
shared_attributes.text: The Recurly record id. Finds one account, invoice, subscription or transaction. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's records. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: Other Recurly fields
shared_attributes.text: Every other field Recurly returns for the record, such as an account's address, custom fields, cc emails and VAT number. Kept for inspection only. A query does not match them and cannot filter on them.

documents.name: Accounts
documents.title: The company. Otherwise the first and last name, then the email, then the account code.
documents.text: `Name`, `Company`, `Email`, `Code` and `State` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the account was last updated, or created when there is no update time.

attributes.name: email
attributes.text: The account's email, in the `Email` line and the title when there is no company or name. Identifies the account as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: username
attributes.text: The account's username, when Recurly has one. Identifies the account as a person in the graph, even without an email. Not searchable.

attributes.name: company, first_name, last_name, code
attributes.text: The company, name and account code, in the title and the `Name`, `Company` and `Code` lines.

attributes.name: state
attributes.text: The account's state, in the `State` line.

documents.name: Invoices
documents.title: `Invoice <number> - <account>`, with the account shown as its company, name, email or code.
documents.text: The customer notes, then `Account`, `State`, `Total` and `Balance` with the currency, `Due date` and `Line items` lines. Each line item shows its description. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the invoice was last updated, or created when there is no update time.

attributes.name: account
attributes.text: The account the invoice belongs to. Its id links the invoice to the account's document. Its name is in the title and the `Account` line. The id itself is not searchable.

attributes.name: number
attributes.text: The invoice number, in the title.

attributes.name: line_items
attributes.text: Each line's description, in the `Line items` line. Other line details are not searchable.

documents.name: Subscriptions
documents.title: `<plan name> subscription - <account>`.
documents.text: The customer notes, then `Plan`, `Account`, `State`, `Amount` (the unit amount with its currency), `Quantity` and `Current period ends` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the subscription was last updated, or created when there is no update time.

attributes.name: account
attributes.text: The subscribed account. Its id links the subscription to the account's document. Its name is in the title and the `Account` line. The id itself is not searchable.

attributes.name: plan
attributes.text: The plan name, in the title and the `Plan` line. Plans are not their own documents.

documents.name: Transactions
documents.title: `Transaction <amount> <currency> - <account>`.
documents.text: The customer message, then `Account`, `Amount`, `Status`, `Type`, `Origin`, `Invoice` (the invoice number) and `Collected at` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the transaction was last updated. Otherwise when it was created, then when it was collected.

attributes.name: account
attributes.text: The paying account. Its id links the transaction to the account's document. Its name is in the title and the `Account` line. The id itself is not searchable.

attributes.name: invoice
attributes.text: The invoice number, in the `Invoice` line. It is text only. The transaction is not linked to the invoice's document.

example_searches: What is the outstanding balance on Acme Corp's latest Recurly invoice?
Which plan is Acme Corp subscribed to, and when does the current period end?
Did the payment from jane@example.com on 2026-11-02 succeed?

connections: Transactions are not linked to their invoice. The invoice number is in the text only.
people: Each account, as a person identified by its email and username.
graph.from_text: Account details, customer notes and messages, plan names, line items and the rest of each record's summary.

not_synced: Billing info, adjustments, coupons, coupon redemptions, plans and plan add-ons as documents.
Account custom fields, addresses and billing details as searchable text. They are stored for inspection only.
Deletions: records deleted in Recurly stay in HydraDB.
